dialogues.speaker: Connoisseur Catalog
dialogues.text: This is the Connoisseur Catalog. Peruse wares of beauty exquisite and bright, and demeanor elegant and gentle. Don't be shy, pick as you please.

dialogues.speaker: Connoisseur Catalog
dialogues.text: They say "The beauty of water is in the pearls it holds." I hope you may take this bright pearl necklace to give its gentle purity a proper home.

dialogues.speaker: Connoisseur Catalog
dialogues.text: The names of the flowers on this painted boat are:

dialogues.speaker: Connoisseur Catalog
dialogues.text: Black Jade, White Jade, Colored Jade, Jasper Hairpin, Hidden Flower...

dialogues.speaker: Connoisseur Catalog
dialogues.text: Artful Spring, Luminescent Gem, Colored Emerald, Intimate Rain, Young Emerald...

dialogues.speaker: Connoisseur Catalog
dialogues.text: Love Pearl, Black Robe, Brilliant Feathers, Colored Pouch, Distant Vine...
